pages.title: Teddy Celts Chess Set played on the 32 Counties of Ireland chess board
pages.description: In the Ancient land of Hibernia when the Island of Ireland was covered in trees the TeddyCelts (The Irish Teddy Bear) Ruled. The trees provided a very rich woodland which provided the perfect Picnic spots for the Teddycelts. As everyone knows when you go down to the woods today the TeddyCelts are having their Picnics. It become known throughout the world as the best place to live and have fun as no one had to grow up. This made it a very popular place for people to come to. Many others decided they would like to make Ireland their home the Leprechauns and the Fairies enjoyed it so much they named it Tir Na Nog the land of the ever young. As the trees began to disappear from the island the Teddycelts found a new home in the caves of Ireland were they hibernated (which means they had a long sleep). They were happy for the Leprechauns and Fairies to maintain the values of the Teddycelts. Which are truth justice with a little mischief added in by the Leprechauns and the preservation of the child in us all. For centuries these values have been upheld by the Fairies and Leprechauns both on the Island of Ireland and throughout the world were the Fairies and Leprechauns have travelled. Although not too many Leprechauns have travelled, they don’t like to fly, It’s a Fairy thing. While the Teddycelts slept the world changed. Being a grown up suddenly became important. With less and less games being played, and less picnics being had. The Teddycelts were unaware of these changes until one day  a trickle of water landed on the face of Cillin the King of the Teddycelts. This wasn’t just any trickle of water this was a tear of innocence from a child who had just had the words “would you ever just grow up” shouted at them. This horrified and terrified the child so much they started to cry. They had never experienced anything like this before they had cried Before. When they hurt their Knee climbing a Tree, when they scraped their hand falling off their bike and twisted their ankle playing football. This was a completely different feeling like all of a sudden the weight of the whole world was being forced onto them and they had no idea how to cope. This lead to the tear of innocence which is the most potent drop of water in the realm of Tir Na Nog. It cannot be allowed to spread.  When King Cillin felt that drop hit his face, he knew exact what is was and the danger it presented. The loss of the child in us all. King Cillin knew what needed to be done. He woke Queen Ciara and told her of the Danger. They quickly got word to the rest to TeddyCelts in the cave network it was time to rise and restore the child in us all. The Teddy Celts are Back and the first game they are going to play is chess. As everyone knows the game of chess like all game’s worth playing originated in Ireland. The game is set on the island of Ireland featuring the thirty two counties of Ireland as the coloured squares. This means no matter what county in Ireland you are from the Teddycelts will bring the games to you. Chess Set In the days of the ancient Celts even the Teddy Bears were great heroes as they staged epic battles in defence of the young and innocent and the preservation of the child in us all, this year The Teddy Celts are back to restore order. Saoirse the Seer is in the treehouse. Whish is the castle on the edge to keep watch for the grown-ups approaching. Tiernan the knight standing ready with his shield and sword ready to keep away the people who want us to grow up. This grown-up thing is over-rated. They don’t seem to have any fun. Paddy  the bishop with his knowledge of all the ancient games and sideway moves he will help us to outwit the grown-ups and keep us having fun. Cillin the King who is the champion of having fun always ready to play and a laugh that is infectious he has his big shield and sword if things start getting serious. Ciara the Queen who just makes you smile and forget about all your worries and gives you hope for the land of the ever young the land of Tir na Nog. Sean the pawn who is not sure if they said we are going to advance or going to a Dance, so he dressed for both. In playing this game you are keeping alive the traditions of the ancient Teddy Celts, which are truth justice with a little mischief added by the Leprechauns and the preservation of the child in us all. ” Keep being Childish and let the games begin” The 32 counties of  Ireland are Dublin, Cork, Limerick, Galway, Roscommon, Westmeath, Louth, Leitrim, Monaghan, Cavan, Mayo, Sligo, Donegal, Derry, Fermanagh, Tyrone, Clare, Wicklow, Wexford, Kerry, Antrim, Down, Offaly, Tipperary, Kildare, Carlow, Kilkenny, Meath, Waterford, Longford, Armagh, Laois
